Fiscal year ends 31 December. Evidence cutoff 14 September 2026; latest actuals are H1 2026. No forecast replaces an already reported period.\"],[null,null,\"A / E labels\",\"AUM A / P&L E means the AUM quarter is disclosed but individual-quarter financial results are model estimates. H1 and FY earnings remain sourced actual controls. Forecast begins Q3 2026.\"],[null,null,\"Economic basis\",\"Core (company-adjusted) earnings remove non-core acquisition, restructuring and other adjustments, and eliminate consolidation gross-ups. Statutory profit and EPS are retained as historical memo inputs, not mixed into the forecast.\"],[null,null,\"AUM perimeter\",\"Use disclosed fee-paying AUM, excluding uncalled non-fee-paying commitments ($4.9bn at June 2026). Opening and closing AUM are stocks. Net flows and all earnings/costs are period flows.\"],[null,null,\"Average AUM\",\"A simple opening/closing midpoint assumes activity is spread through each quarter. It does not reproduce daily AUM or fund-level fee accrual. Historical fees are allocated by midpoint weights and reconcile to reported H1 and FY.\"],[null,null,\"Management fees\",\"Model net management fees after distribution costs. Forecast applies 56bp, the reported 2025 average, to midpoint AUM with a quarter-year factor. Immaterial service income is absorbed in this blended rate. Historical gross fees and distribution costs are shown separately as memo lines.\"],[null,null,\"Fee margin limitation\",\"The historical implied margin uses midpoint AUM and differs from the published margin. Base deliberately returns to the 2025 average 56bp despite H1 2026 average 52bp and 2025 exit run-rate 52bp. This is the exercise assumption; Downside tests continued 52bp.\"],[null,null,\"Performance-fee timing\",\"Default allocation is Q1 10% / Q2 90% of H1, and Q3 10% / Q4 90% of FY less H1. These are explicit estimates, not disclosed quarter results. Forecast copies the corresponding allocated 2025 quarter. Changing allocation alters quarters but leaves historical H1/FY intact.\"],[null,null,\"Recognition and carry\",\"Fees depend on fund high-water marks, benchmarks, hurdles and crystallisation. The assumed AUM investment return is therefore not multiplied by an incentive rate to generate fees. Earned carry sits within performance fees where applicable. Acquired carry receivables are stocks and are not added to revenue.\"],[null,null,\"Pass-through fees\",\"H1 2026 statutory performance/pass-through fees contain a $19m gross-up, with $18m of associated compensation. Core metrics remove it; the model follows the reported core basis. No unsupported standalone carry or incentive-fee series is created.\"],[null,null,\"Fixed costs\",\"All fixed compensation belongs to the recurring management-fee business. Forecast fixed compensation is $274m / 4 and other fixed costs including D&A $215m / 4. No inflation or incremental cost savings are assumed. Other employment expense stays $7m / 4.\"],[null,null,\"Variable compensation\",\"Management participation is ($481m − $274m) / $1,077m. Performance/seed participation is $194m / ($281m + $38m). The latter attribution links fee costs to fees and seed costs to seed returns while preserving the company-reported total.\"],[null,null,\"Asset servicing\",\"Servicing scales with average total AUM at the 2025 calibrated blended rate. The disclosed approximately 5bp excludes systematic long-only AUM; applying it to total group AUM would use the wrong denominator.\"],[null,null,\"Other earnings items\",\"Seed investment gains and rental income stay at 2025 annual totals / 4. Management and seed financing remain $7m / 4 and $11m / 4. Management third-party profit share stays $2m / 4; performance share scales at $1m / $281m of fee revenue.\"],[null,null,\"Operating profit\",\"Model-defined core operating profit equals net revenue less core operating costs, including D&A and other employment costs. It is before net finance expense and third-party profit allocations. A separate operating-profit line excludes seed gains. Core PBT reconciles to the company.\"],[null,null,\"Tax and EPS\",\"Forecast tax is the unrounded 2025 ratio $86m / $407m. Forecast shares are 1,164.877368m. H1 actuals retain their reported rates and shares. Annual shares are day-weighted, and EPS equals total profit / weighted diluted shares; quarterly EPS is never added to make FY EPS.\"],[null,null,\"AUM other allocations\",\"2024 and 2025 FX totals are disclosed annually. Quarter FX is allocated in proportion to the reported other bucket after acquisitions; 2024 realisations are spread evenly. Residual other preserves each quarter total. n/d components remain in other, not assumed zero. Forecast FX, acquisitions, realisations and other are zero.\"],[null,null,\"Scenario use\",\"Change Assumptions D4: 1 Base; 2 Downside (zero flows, 52bp, half fees); 3 Upside (+2% flows, 58bp, 1.5× fees); 4 Zero PF (base AUM/margin, no forecast performance fees). Individual forecast quarters are editable. One engine recalculates every case.\"],[null,null,\"Zero-fee interpretation\",\"Historical H1 2026 performance fees of $207m remain actual in every case. Only forecast performance fees become zero. FY2027 shows a full year without performance fees. Seed gains, their compensation and seed funding remain; Zero PF is not a zero-investment-income case.\"],[null,null,\"Checks\",\"AUM reconciles quarterly to source; fees, cost components, both PBT streams, tax, profit and weighted shares reconcile to H1/FY controls. EPS differences within 0.10 US cents reflect rounded published dollar profits and share counts. Allocation identities are labelled separately from source tie-outs.\"],[null,null,\"Refresh\",\"Add the next quarter AUM bridge and next H1/FY financial control, preserve previous sources, replace affected forecast cells with allocation formulas, and move the forecast cutoff. Rebase exercise assumptions only deliberately; do not automatically substitute new management guidance.\"],[null,null,\"Verification\",\"Recalculated every case, confirmed historical invariance, tested a later-quarter driver and missing selected/unselected inputs, and inspected each sheet. Reopened the exported workbook to verify formulas, comments and outputs. Native Excel verification is recorded in the accompanying model record.\"]]}",

Fiscal year ends 31 December. Evidence cutoff 14 September 2026; latest actuals are H1 2026. No forecast replaces an already reported period.\"],[null,null,\"A / E labels\",\"AUM A / P&L E means the AUM quarter is disclosed but individual-quarter financial results are model estimates. H1 and FY earnings remain sourced actual controls. Forecast begins Q3 2026.\"],[null,null,\"Economic basis\",\"Core (company-adjusted) earnings remove non-core acquisition, restructuring and other adjustments, and eliminate consolidation gross-ups. Statutory profit and EPS are retained as historical memo inputs, not mixed into the forecast.\"],[null,null,\"AUM perimeter\",\"Use disclosed fee-paying AUM, excluding uncalled non-fee-paying commitments ($4.9bn at June 2026). Opening and closing AUM are stocks. Net flows and all earnings/costs are period flows.\"],[null,null,\"Average AUM\",\"A simple opening/closing midpoint assumes activity is spread through each quarter. It does not reproduce daily AUM or fund-level fee accrual. Historical fees are allocated by midpoint weights and reconcile to reported H1 and FY.\"],[null,null,\"Management fees\",\"Model net management fees after distribution costs. Forecast applies 56bp, the reported 2025 average, to midpoint AUM with a quarter-year factor. Immaterial service income is absorbed in this blended rate. Historical gross fees and distribution costs are shown separately as memo lines.\"],[null,null,\"Fee margin limitation\",\"The historical implied margin uses midpoint AUM and differs from the published margin. Base deliberately returns to the 2025 average 56bp despite H1 2026 average 52bp and 2025 exit run-rate 52bp. This is the exercise assumption; Downside tests continued 52bp.\"],[null,null,\"Performance-fee timing\",\"Default allocation is Q1 10% / Q2 90% of H1, and Q3 10% / Q4 90% of FY less H1. These are explicit estimates, not disclosed quarter results. Forecast copies the corresponding allocated 2025 quarter. Changing allocation alters quarters but leaves historical H1/FY intact.\"],[null,null,\"Recognition and carry\",\"Fees depend on fund high-water marks, benchmarks, hurdles and crystallisation. The assumed AUM investment return is therefore not multiplied by an incentive rate to generate fees. Earned carry sits within performance fees where applicable. Acquired carry receivables are stocks and are not added to revenue.\"],[null,null,\"Pass-through fees\",\"H1 2026 statutory performance/pass-through fees contain a $19m gross-up, with $18m of associated compensation. Core metrics remove it; the model follows the reported core basis. No unsupported standalone carry or incentive-fee series is created.\"],[null,null,\"Fixed costs\",\"All fixed compensation belongs to the recurring management-fee business. Forecast fixed compensation is $274m / 4 and other fixed costs including D&A $215m / 4. No inflation or incremental cost savings are assumed. Other employment expense stays $7m / 4.\"],[null,null,\"Variable compensation\",\"Management participation is ($481m − $274m) / $1,077m. Performance/seed participation is $194m / ($281m + $38m). The latter attribution links fee costs to fees and seed costs to seed returns while preserving the company-reported total.\"],[null,null,\"Asset servicing\",\"Servicing scales with average total AUM at the 2025 calibrated blended rate. The disclosed approximately 5bp excludes systematic long-only AUM; applying it to total group AUM would use the wrong denominator.\"],[null,null,\"Other earnings items\",\"Seed investment gains and rental income stay at 2025 annual totals / 4. Management and seed financing remain $7m / 4 and $11m / 4. Management third-party profit share stays $2m / 4; performance share scales at $1m / $281m of fee revenue.\"],[null,null,\"Operating profit\",\"Model-defined core operating profit equals net revenue less core operating costs, including D&A and other employment costs. It is before net finance expense and third-party profit allocations. A separate operating-profit line excludes seed gains. Core PBT reconciles to the company.\"],[null,null,\"Tax and EPS\",\"Forecast tax is the unrounded 2025 ratio $86m / $407m. Forecast shares are 1,164.877368m. H1 actuals retain their reported rates and shares. Annual shares are day-weighted, and EPS equals total profit / weighted diluted shares; quarterly EPS is never added to make FY EPS.\"],[null,null,\"AUM other allocations\",\"2024 and 2025 FX totals are disclosed annually. Quarter FX is allocated in proportion to the reported other bucket after acquisitions; 2024 realisations are spread evenly. Residual other preserves each quarter total. n/d components remain in other, not assumed zero. Forecast FX, acquisitions, realisations and other are zero.\"],[null,null,\"Scenario use\",\"Change Assumptions D4: 1 Base; 2 Downside (zero flows, 52bp, half fees); 3 Upside (+2% flows, 58bp, 1.5× fees); 4 Zero PF (base AUM/margin, no forecast performance fees). Individual forecast quarters are editable. One engine recalculates every case.\"],[null,null,\"Zero-fee interpretation\",\"Historical H1 2026 performance fees of $207m remain actual in every case. Only forecast performance fees become zero. FY2027 shows a full year without performance fees. Seed gains, their compensation and seed funding remain; Zero PF is not a zero-investment-income case.\"],[null,null,\"Checks\",\"AUM reconciles quarterly to source; fees, cost components, both PBT streams, tax, profit and weighted shares reconcile to H1/FY controls. EPS differences within 0.10 US cents reflect rounded published dollar profits and share counts. Allocation identities are labelled separately from source tie-outs.\"],[null,null,\"Refresh\",\"Add the next quarter AUM bridge and next H1/FY financial control, preserve previous sources, replace affected forecast cells with allocation formulas, and move the forecast cutoff. Rebase exercise assumptions only deliberately; do not automatically substitute new management guidance.\"],[null,null,\"Verification\",\"Recalculated every case, confirmed historical invariance, tested a later-quarter driver and missing selected/unselected inputs, and inspected each sheet. Reopened the exported workbook to verify formulas, comments and outputs. Native Excel verification is recorded in the accompanying model record.\"]]}",
